functionality.rationale: Integrated schema-v4 records currently break the lifecycle fixture before CI, while the self-referential verified-SHA precondition blocks evidence collection after otherwise successful CI.

security.rationale: The repair must isolate synthetic lifecycle state and replace an impossible self-reference with exact candidate binding without fabricating evidence or weakening remote validation.

performance.rationale: Collection and fixture setup add bounded Git metadata reads once per acceptance or governance fixture.

compatibility.rationale: Integrated records keep verified_sha empty until acceptance, and inherited fixture records, accepted records, and existing bundles must retain their exact validation contract.

concurrency.rationale: Collection must reject intervening checkout changes while fixture rewriting must remain isolated from the caller worktree.

platform.rationale: Both repairs use portable Git plumbing and Python already required by the acceptance harness.

persistence.rationale: Fixture records must be restored verbatim and durable criterion evidence must bind its source record, workflow run, artifacts, and bundle to one immutable candidate SHA.

adr.rationale: The task restores the approved schema-v4 fixture and exact-candidate acceptance order and changes no public contract or expensive-to-reverse decision.

architecture.rationale: The change is confined to internal lifecycle-fixture preparation and criterion-evidence collection.

roadmap.rationale: The task unblocks governed delivery and adds no product behavior or milestone.

failure_fingerprints: FAILED: integrated candidate evidence requires no precommitted verified SHA
FAILED: integrated schema-v4 lifecycle state is not isolated

defect.symptom: An integrated schema-v4 task first makes repository verification reject fabricated fixture state and, after fixture isolation, evidence collection rejects the empty pre-acceptance verified_sha even when remote CI passes.
defect.expected_contract: Repository verification isolates inherited integrated state, then acceptance collects exact-candidate evidence while verified_sha is empty and atomically binds the SHA and bundle.
defect.actual_behavior: The fixture fabricates done state without evidence and the collector then requires the delivery commit to contain its own SHA, so neither standalone repair can complete schema-v4 acceptance.
defect.trigger: Run make verify or agent.sh accept with any integrated schema-v4 squash or cherry-pick delivery.
